items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I heard so many great stories about him from fellows that worked with him like Tab Jordan

ctx.x: He really got them, I knew him very well.

Yeah, real dapper. And that was another inspiration for me, you know, when I came to New York. And to think that although I idolized Chick Webb's playing, I never did see him in person. When I came to New York, he had taken sick and he was in the hospital, and I never had the pleasure of seeing him in person. But I heard so many great stories about him from fellows that worked with him like Tab Jordan and Elmer Williams, and they used to tell me different things that he used to do on the drums, and I would try to…
Uh huh. Did you ever run into Zutty Singleton or Big Sid or any of those guys?
